content: Speak such words that will bring peace to your own heart and fill others with serene joy.
author: Kabir
explanation: Words carry vibrational weight. Speaking with humility and gentleness cools down anger in both the speaker and the listener, turning speech into healing medicine.
practicalInsight: Before speaking in any difficult conversation today, soften your tone and ensure your words bring light rather than heat.
reflectionPrompt: Does my speech build bridges of peace or erect walls of defense?
